scene: The leafy face ruffles its foliage and whispers a secret riddle.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left, a swirling emerald portal churns within a hollow oak. The grandmother in pink tracksuit stands next to it, her white dog sniffing the grass. In the centre, the face-shaped hedge murmurs with open leafy lips. To the right stands the still brass robot gardener, before the mansion on the far right.
shown: a talking hedge with a leafy mustache whispering in the centre
a motionless brass robot gardener holding golden shears on the right
a swirling emerald portal open inside a hollow tree far left
